la ༄/ /snga a+thi+-i yo gter (5 chos skor gos bsgrigs/ gungatshi rnya ltadzo lta r+sānga wor da sa dang bdud chubabasnganardorjedran pod ga go/ 33 tshe
༄7/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod so gsum pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje ni/ la stod mnga' ris glo bo khul du bod rab byung dgu pa'i chu sprel sprel zla'i tshes bcu/ spyi lo 1512lor sku bltams/ sku chung dus yab 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dang gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po sogs mkhas grub mang du bsten nas chos bka' mang du zhus/ gsan bsam dang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin par mdzad/ gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen dang lhan du bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang gsang sgrom nas rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / 'on phu stag tshang nas drag po dbu dgu'i chos skor dang / dgung grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig la 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas sgo phye ste lha ri rin chen snying po nas tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal zhi drag sogs zab gter mang du bzhes/ gsang mtshan la rdo rje gro lod rtsal dang / nyi zla 'od zeX/dpad+ma zhugago po sogasago su sngigs/ brgyud 'aXn nigo byang bdag pa ༷byis rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dang 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po sogs slob tshogs gang mang byung / mthar rab byung
༄༅/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam so gsum pa'i nang bzhugs/ lha btsun rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis bsam yas rnam snang thugs ka nas spyan drangs ba'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol dang / lha ri rin chen snying po'i brag nas spyan drangs ba'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis la pod gcig bzhugs pa las/ dang po thugs chen skor la/ chos rgyal mos gus grub pas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen pe'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/2(1) zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol las lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba/3 (5) sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/5 (11) dbang chog bde chen dbyings sbyor/9 (21) snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang /5 (39) zab rgya'i rdzogs rim 'ja' lus mchog sbyin/10 (49) 'pho ba'i man ngag ye shes zang thal/3 (69) bar do gnad kyi man ngag8 (75) bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa myong grol mchog gter/2 (91) las tshogs 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod 4 (95) lung bstan nyi ma'i snying po/9 (103) zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol kyi las byang ye shes 'khor lo/8 (121) kha byang gter gyi bang mdzod/3 (137) snying byang rgyas pa gnad kyi thems bu/9 (143)

༄tshi/ /ye shes/6 (555) 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga rten 'brel gnad kyi 'khor lo/9 (567) 'khor lo'i tshe sgrub yid bzhin 'khor lo/5 (585) bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'chi med tshe'i rgyud/23 (595) sgrub khog dngos grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs sgrub chen mo/35 (641) sgrub chen gyi cha rkyen las bzhi'i sbyin sreg me hom dang bcas pa las bzhi lhun grub/8 (71 1) bsang mchod bar chad kun sel/7 (727) par byang smon tshig1(741—742) bcas bzhugs/ chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun du grags gyur te/ /blo gros pad+mo rab tu rgyas byed cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /dge'o// //
do༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i brgyud pa'i gsola'adebasabazhugs so//
༄tsho/ /oX āXhūm̐X/ chos dbyings gru 'dzin dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /rang rig mi 'gyur thugs rje chen po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ka dag rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam dag pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /rig rtsal 'gag med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /lhun grub rtsal snang rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas su/ /rgyal ba bskyed yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so: khregs chod gtan la phebs par byin: thugs rje'i 'phrin las thog med gzhal yas su/ /sna nam rig 'dzin rdo rje'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so: snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis: mos gus gdung shugs 'bral med zhing khams su/ /sangs rgyas kun
༄tshi/ /dngos bdud 'joms rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so zo rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /thugs rgyud bka' babs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la: /gsol ba 'debs: 'phrin las mtha' khyab 'grub par byin: /rang lus phung khams rnam dag gzhal yas su/ /thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i lha tshogs la/ gsol bzo mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin za dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa'i gzhal yas su/ /gter bdag ḍā ke dam can rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba : zab gter bstan pa rgyas par byin: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ /theg mchog lam gyi bsgrod pa kun rdzogs nas/ /rig 'dzin bzhi 'dus don gnyis mthar phyin nyid/ /dka' ba med par tshe 'dir thob par therdzog /gnas skabs gnyis 'dzin 'gal rkyen bar chad rnams/ /
gnyis med ye shes rdo rjes gzhom byas nas/ /'chi med tshe dang dpal 'byor phun tshogs shing / /'gro kun phyam gcig gdod ma'i gnas thob phregag /zhesazab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debasamador bsdusapa 'di yang rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i thugs sras rdo rje 'dzin pa rig 'dzin bsod namasargyal mtshan pa'i thugs bzhed ltar/ snyom las pa chosargyal mosagusagrub pas mgyogs par brisapa dgo'o// //

ra༅༅caX caXbadag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: gza' bdud dug gi spu gri yi: gsol mchod rim pa bstan par bya: 'di la lhasapa'i mthun rdzasarnams: tshang zhing bkod legs bshams nas kyang : rgyu dusadag dang zer gnyisdus: sngagasa'adisa'agugs shing phud kyisamachod: oX h+ya kṛ wa hūṃX badz+ra ra hu la tsit+ta shaka ru raX ma ma yong za 'gram ha he dza dzacaX rdzas bsregs rol dbyangs bcas te bskul: hūXcaX sngon tshe dbang chen pad+ma he ru gsacaX dam la btags pa'i chos skyong mthu rtsal cana'oX drang srong chen po gza' mchog ra hū lacaX thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolacaX drag po'i cha lugs dud kha mun pa'i mdogacaX dbu dgu spyan stong bstan la bya ra mdzadacaX zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs nad kyi na bun 'khrigasacaX phyag g.yas chu srin rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba yisacaX 'gal byed khyur mid thar ba'i dus skabs medacaX gaskurdzon pa mda'
gzhus nyams pa'i snying la gzeracaX sku smad sbrul mjug klu bdud pho nyar 'gyedacaX 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo dkrugs sdebs srid gsum g.yo'oX sprul pa'i gza' brgyad gdong mo kha bzhi dang caX lha srin sde brgyad rgyu skar nyi shu'i tshogasacaX rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes lacaX rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pad+ma he ru gcaX shrī seng ha pad+ma'i spyan snga 〈tshoX ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas dran mdzod lacaX bdag la sdang ba'i las ngan dgra bo 'di'oX chos skyong khyed la gsod pa'i gnyer du gtadacaX lo zlar ma bzhag myur du sgrol bar mdzodacaX pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud mngal nas skemasacaX dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po don snying bcasacaX khyod kyi zas skal mthun rdzas ma yin nama'oX srog chod snying phyungs sha rus dum bur gtubasacaX bzhes shig rol cig dam nyams dgra la rolacaX pha tshan bdun rgyud thams cad rtsad
nas 31da: ming tsam med par thal ba'i rdul du lce(ga: cesabaskul yi dam nga rgyal gyis: mchod la gang 'dod 'phrin las bcol: dam tshig nan bsgrags gong non gces: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rno myur khyad 'phags thog 'dra ba'i: chosaskyong khyab 'jug mchod bskul 'di: yang zab chosakyi bsrung mar sba: bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar shog: sam ya: rgya rgya rgya:sgrub thabasazur du yod pa ltar bya: gdong gtad gdab lasasogs mngon spyod kho na'i lasatshogs 'dug pa ni: snyigs dusakyi skye bosalog par spyad dogs pasaspel bar ma byas so: 'khor+sāmed bdud 'joms kyi.u pa de sha: 9khoX kha reg kun bzang gling zhesapar/ /me 'brug sa ga zla ba yi/ /nyer lnga'i srod thun dang po la/ /rig 'dzin sprul sku chen po'i drung / /lung bstan lo rgyusasgrub thabasanas/ /bka' bsrung ma gtogs tshang ba rnams/ /lung nod bri bar zhusapa'i tshe/ /phyiszhig rdzogs par sbyin no gsungs/ /de nasalo gsum 'dasapa yi/ /r+sāmo lug lo nag pa zla'i/ /mar ngo'i bzang po dang po la/ /snye mo chosargyal gzhisakha ru/ /bu yig phyag dpe rtsal ba na/ /skal ba cung zhig ldan no snyam/ /chad lhag log pa'i skyon med par/ /shog ser bu lasazhal bshusbyas/ /lhongs kyi rnams pa cher byung yang / /bar chad dbang du ma therdzor ba/ /rig 'dzin rje yi bka' drin yin/ /thag chod myong ba med mod kyang / smon lam cung zhig btab pa des/ /zab chosaphrad tshog 'di dang mjal/ /a la la ho nyams re dga'/ /bkrashisadapal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du 31ga maṅgalaX// //
༄tsho/ /thugs rje chen po'i byang bu brtag thabs bzhugs so//
༄tsho/ /che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs drug gnas 'dren byed pa byang bu bzhu bar 'dod na/ byang mes brtag pa ni/ mar me'i smon lam 'debs khar me kha dog lnga brtag pa ni/ dang po me dkar la 'od che ba ni 'og min na sangs rgya'o/ /dkar gsal dwangs shing rtse mo zlum du 'dug na shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du sangs rgya'o/ /rab tu 'bar zhing pad+ma 'dra na las rab rdzogs par sangs rgya'o/ /rgyal mtshan dbyibs kha dog ser na dpal dang ldan par sangs rgya'o/ /mdog dmar pad+ma 'dra na bde ba can du sangs rgya'o/ /du ba che zhing me 'bar na rkyen du grib langs nas dud 'gro'i gnas su skye/ de'i skye sgo sgog pa la gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ tshwa tshwa dang / rnam par snang mdzad thub dbang la sogs bzhengs na/ yul dbus su btsan po dang gtso bo pha spun sogs la skye/ yang du
༄tshi/ /ba dang me nag thom du 'dug na/ mar me rgyal mtshan tshe 'bar dang / ngan song sbyongs rgyud/ kun rig stong rtsa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sku dang / phyag rdor sku dang gzungs/ gra lnga sogs bzhengs na/ rang gi yul thag nye ba gcig tu pha ma bsags pa can gyi bu mo gsum gyi 'bring por skye/ de tshe 'phos nas mkha' 'gro'i gling du skye'o/ /yang me tshag tshig me stag 'phros nas rkyen dmyal bar 'gro/ de la mi 'khrugs pa'i sku dang / rdor sems sku/ yig brgya/ na raka bskong bshags 'don/ spyan ras gzigs sogs bzhengs pha ma bsags pa can gyi bur skye/ yang me rnyu tshag zhing sngo na yi ge brgya pa/ gang ka ni/ dri med bshags rgyud/ mdo thar pa chen po/ tshe 'bar/ sdig bshags ltung bshags/ bka' 'bum spyan dbye sogs mang du byas na lam mam chu'i pha rol tu ban bon
dang shing bzo ba gang rigs kyi bur skye'o/ /yang na rang gi nye ba'i bur skye/ de ma byas na sgo khyi la skyes nas smyos nas thams cad la gnod pa skyal nas dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye dge rtsa rims cig yang me ser na mdangs med par 'das na/ yi dwags su skye/ de la rin chen 'byung ldan la nye sras brgyad kyi bskor ba'am 'jam dbyangs sku dang gzungs thub pa la gnas bcus bskor ba sogs bzhengs na 'di nas lho phyogs su bla ma'am sman pa/ sngags pa'am/ rigs bzang du skyes nas chos byed do/ /yang me ser la 'tshub cing ther ba ser yas kyi song na gtor ma brgya rtsa/ ma nus pa la sbyin gtong bya ston/ byis ston/ lan chags gtor ma/ jam ser dang rin chen mkha' 'gre'i sku bzhengs/ lho phyogs dgon pa la mang ja tshe 'bar sogs byas na/ rang gi nang dang bu sring mo'i bur skye'o/ /de ma byas na yi dwags su skye/ yang dmar zhing 'tshub na lha ma yin du skye/ de la yum chen mo'am tshe dpag med stong sku'am bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ tshogs brgya byas na nub tu pha ma bsags pa can gyi bu'am rig 'dzin gyi bur skyes nas sems can gyi don byed do/ /yang mar me dmar tshag me stse 'thor nas dmar gzhong du 'dug na mdo dkon brtsegs dang / na rag bskongs bshags/ mar me rgyal mtshan/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod nub kyi mchod rten la sku dkar dang / zhi khro sogs
༄༅/ /byas na 'di nas nub tu mgar ba'am bzo bo'i bur skye/ yang me mdangs med thung zhing rtsub pa byung na/ byang du mkha' lding ngam dgra bo'i gnyen du skye bas/ don yod grub pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sam/ sman bla'i sku/ byams sku sogs bzhengs na/ 'di nas byang ngos nas sde dpon gyi bur skye'am rang gi nye ba'i bur skye/ yang me sngo'am nag 'tshub 'dug na thal ba nag por byung na/gzungs 'dus mtshan brjod/ sgrol ma sku dkar ram/ lam zam mam/ ri rab brtsegs pa sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum byams smon/ ma ṇaṃ dung phyur sogs gang rigs cig byas na yul gyi gtso bo'am sde dpon gyi bu la skye'o/ /maṅga laX// //

༄༅/ /khrid kyi sabacad rim khang nyer lnga pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /na mo gu ru sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+ya ya/ rim khang dang po byung tshul gtan la dbab pa/ gnyis pa snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bstan pa/ gsum pa 'bor ba'i chos rab tu dbye ba/ bzhi pa grub mtha'i dbye ba/ lnga pa gsang chen nges pa'i don dka' ba'i gnas bstan pa/ drug pa gzhi'i don smin par byed pa'i dbang gi rnam par bzhag pa/ bdun pa dam tshig rnam par bkod pa/ brgyad pa gdod ma'i gzhi'i gnas lugs bstan pa/ dgu pa lhun grub snang tshul gyi sgo la 'khor 'das kyi mdo bstan pa/ bcu pa 'khrul lugs zlog tshul dang bcas pa'i brdas mtshon pa/ bcu gcig pa bag chags las kyi grub tshul/ bcu gnyis pa gnas nges pa bye brag du bshad pa/ bcu gsum pa sgron bzhi'i rnam grangs bstan pa/ bcu bzhi pa rten pa shes pa'i gnas rnam par bzhag pa/ bco lnga pa
༄tshi/ /'byung ba'i gnas bstan pa/ bcu drug pa dbyings dang ye shes lhun kyi grub pa'i gnas bstan pa/ bcu bdun pa dmigs pa yul gyis blo rim can 'jug pa'i lam zab rgya cher bshad pa/bco brgyad pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po lam gyi chings bstan pa/ bcu dgu pa yang rab rtogs pa'i grol ba'i man ngag gi tshig bstan pa/ nyi shu pa thod rgal ye shes nyams su len pa'i gnad nges pa/nyer gcig pa rdo rje'i gnas dka' ba ngo sprod la brten nas mtshon pa/ nyer gnyis pa dus gsum rtags kyi rnam grangs gtan la phabs pa/ nyer gsum pa rang snang bar do'i 'char tshul bstan pa/nyer bzhi pa dbang po tha ma rnams rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ba/ nyer lnga pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras bu rnam par bzhag pa rnams so/ /sarba maṅga laX// //
༄tsho/ /thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyingasasgrol gyi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid yig rig 'dzin zhalalung bzhugs so//
༄༅/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dang legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo pad ma thod 'phreng rtsal dang dbyer ma mchis pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi'i zhabs kyi pad mar gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ /bde ldan zhing na chos sku 'od mtha' yas/ /gru 'dzin la dgyes longs sku pad dkar 'chang / /sin+tu rgya mtshor sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med byang chub bar du snying dbus bzhugs/ /sna nam sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgyu dra'i gar/ /gter chen nyi zla 'od zer chos kyi rgyal/ /legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje dpal bzang po/ /bslu med gtan gyi skyabs khyod gtsug na mdzes/ /dpal brtsegs yang srid bsod nams rnam par rgyal/ /dzñā na'i rnam sprul chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /bi
༄༅caX caXma'i zlos gar blo mchog rdo rje'i zhabs/ /be+e ro dngos byon gter bdag gling pa rgyal/ /'khor med drin las khregs chod thod rgal gyi/ /zab mo'i lam bzang mngon sum bstan pa'i mthus/sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig tu/ /'phrod pas dad pa dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /de phyir 'khor 'das gnyis su rang grol ba'i/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i dmar khrid gzhung /bdag dang skal mnyam mang por phan pa'i ched/ /nyams len gsal byed rig 'dzin zhal lung spel/ /de'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid nyams su len pa la rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / rdzogs rim 'ja' lus mchog sbyin/ de'i dgongs 'grel chos bdag ba le ba rnam rgyal dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gsal byed nor bu'i phreng bar lung skyor yang

༄༅ltoX ltoXpar: ye grol ka dag rtogs par: chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar: nyams snang gong du 'phel bar: rig pa tshad la phebs par: chos rnams zad par 'khyol bar: myur du sangs rgyas thobacu ces pa : rigs dang : rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs so/ /zhes pa brgya phrag tsam gyis snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo dpral ba'i oX las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po byung ba rang gi spyir bor thim pas rtse mo rnam bkod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs sum brgya drug cu gang bas lus sgrib dag bum dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgoms pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub/ de bzhin du gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo mgrin pa'i āXlas 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po byung ba rang gi mgrin par thim pas ro 'dus 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs bcu drug gang bas ngag sgrib dag gsang dbang thob/ lam gtum mo: 'bras bu longs sku: thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od dang bdud rtsi sngon po byung ba rang gi snying khar thim pas snying ka dran pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs brgyad gang bas yid sgrib dag sher dbang thob/ lam dga' bzhi: 'bras bu chos sku 'grub/ ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo lte ba'i hrī4༷༷ma las 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po dang mthing ga byung ba rang gi lte bar
thim pas skyed byed 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab re bzhi gang bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa: rig pa'i rtsal dbang : lam rdzogs pa chen po: 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu rang rig kun tu bzang po gdod ma nas rang la gnas kyang de nyid ngo 'phrod pa bla ma la rag las pas bla ma chos skur bltas te gsol ba btab pas chos nyid kyi don rtogs/ longs skur bltas pas sku dang zhing khams kyi yon tan skye/ sprul skur bltas pas sa lam gyi yon tan skye ba'i phyir rnal 'byor 'di nyid lam thams cad rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /lnga pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ bsod nams mi zad rgya mtsho spel ba'i phyiraltoX phyi nang gsang gsum maṇ+ḍal tshogs 'khor bya/ zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la sngon byung bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang tshogs gnyis gsog par mdzad pas nges par gal che zhing pha rol tu phyin pas lugs la dka' ba brgya phrag spyod pa rnams 'dir maṇ+ḍal du bsdus te thabs zab mo'i sgo nas mdzad pas phyi'i maṇ+ḍal la gser dngul/ mkhar ba rdo shing sogs ñtsu 'byor ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang tshom bu'i rgyur gro nas kyis mtshon pa sta gon bya/ bla ma sprul sku'i zhing la gling bzhi ri rab/ nyi zla sogs dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te/ na mo dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la/ zhes sogs kyis 'bul/ bla ma longs sku'i zhing la
༄tshiltoX ltoXnang gi maṇ+ḍal sgrub pa po rang nyid tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du sha khrag rus pa dang gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gcig tu byas te/ hūm̐X rang lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i wo brang dugiX zhes sogs brjod/ bla ma chos sku'i zhing la gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal dngos sam yid kyis gzung ma 'bul te/ hūṃX pad+ma can sogs yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs4༷༷ sked phra nu 'bur bha ga mngon par rgyas4༷༷ dbang po drug la dga' ba'i dpal ster bltoX nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su bkang ste phul4༷༷ mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin dugiX dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu drangs pa'igiX bde stong ye shes mchog gi dgyes bskyed nas4༷༷thabs lam zab mos tshe 'dir grol byin rlobs4༷༷ zhes brjod/ bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi zhing la yang gsang spros pa med pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ rang sems mkha' la mchod bya mchod byed yul4༷༷ sprin 'ja' ltar snang sems nyid gcig pus 'phrul4༷༷ blo 'das rig ngo 'phrod pa'i mchod pa yis4༷༷ sprol bral ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs4༷༷ zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas tshogs bsags nas mchod yul gyi bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang sems dang dbyer med du khrig gis 'dres pa/ nang gi 'byung ba bzhi 'od dkar ser dmar ljang du zhu/ phyi rol gyi 'byung ba bzhi yang 'od du zhu ste nang gi 'byung ba bzhi la thim/ 'od des rigs
drug gi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha yi ngo bor shig ge sgrar grags tshad chos kyi sgra dir re/ sems gsal stong du ye re ba'i ngang nas rang babs su mnyam par 'jog maṇ+ḍal phul bas gnas skabs su dngos po la zhen pa ldog cing longs spyod 'phel/ zhing khams bzang por skye/ bla ma ngo bo nyid skur bltas nas phul bas rig pa kun tu bzang por ngo 'phrod/ chos skur bltas pas nges don gyi yon tan rgyud la skye/ longs skur bltas pas sku dang zhing khams rgyas/ sprul skur bltas pas 'gro ba dpag med 'dren par nus pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa rgyud la skye zhing rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs gsogs nus pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /rdzogs chen gzhan la skabs 'dir ku su la'i tshogs bsags yod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin kyang gter gzhung du mi gsal bas btang snyoms su bzhag la spro na gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /drug pa bsrung 'khor dang / bdun pa bum dbang gnyis ni/ phyi nang mtshams bcad sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrangs te4༷༷ bsnyen sgrub rdzogs nas bum dbang legs par bskuraltoX zhes pa ltar dbang bskur ba'i sngon du slob dpon bsnyen pa'i kha gso byed pa'i ched du srung 'bor bsgom zhing gzhung bsrangs nas bsnyen sgrub byas te bum dbang bskur rjes bum dbang gi khrid
༄tshiltoX ltoX'adebs des mtshon 'og ma'i khrid rnams kyi mgor so so'i dbang bskur ba la dgongs shing rgyas par spro na de ltar legs mod 'jug pa bde phyir dbang thams cad gong du bskur ba'i lugs su bgyis nas ma spros so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ brtson 'grus rab tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba/ 'bring bar dor 'tshang rgya ba/ tha ma dang sdig can btsan thabs 'pho ba'i gdams pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po la bum dbang gi 'khrid/ gsang dbang gi 'khrid/ sher dbang gi 'khrid/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang gi 'khrid dang bzhi'i/ /dang po bum dbang gi lam snang stong lha'i bskyed rim gyi 'khrid la/ phyi nang bden 'dzin 'khrul pa dag bya'i phyiraltoX gsal stong sgyu 'phrul lha yi bskyed rim bsgoms4༷༷ zhes pa ltar bskyed pa ma hā yo ga lung a nu yo ga rdzogs pa a ti yo ga dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang rig hrīXzhes pa'i stong nyid kyi don chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ka dag chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las de ltar ma rtogs pas don dam par de bzhin du ma rig pa'i dbang gis bden par bzung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams la brtse bas snying rje chen po gdangs 'gags med du shar ba longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer mi phyed pa'i
rang gdangs de'i ngang nas chu las chu lhar rdol ba ltar rang gi rig pa hrīX dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa lam gyis shar ba ni sprul sku rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin/ de las 'od zer sngo ljang dkar ser dmar po rnams kyi thig pa chad pa las 'byung ba lnga rim brtsegs su bskyed/ de'i steng du bhuX yig chad pa las 'og gzhi sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi'i steng du rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dmar dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i brtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu phyed 'phyang la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ sgyu 'phrul du 'dod rnams kyi kha 'gram pha gus bskor bar bshad pas mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing snga ma ltar na de'i steng rin po che'i bre phul gyis btegs pa'i gser gyi spang leb gyi kha nas dra ba dang dra phyed 'phyangs pa/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i pad+ma'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa gdung zlum gyis bskor bar phyam sne nang ma dang phyi ma gser gyi ska rags la bkal ba'i bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i mda' yab spyi blugs kha thur du bstan pa'i dbyibs can de'i steng du pu shu pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pas rnam pas bskor bar gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas spras pa/ dbus kyi re'u mig gi steng nas ka chung gis btegs pa'i rgya phibs rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa/ snga 'gyur gyi gzhung la lar 'di yan
༄tshiltoX ltoXmachod rten gyi bum pa'i dbyibs 'dod pa'ang yod/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab snam bu bzhi la 'khor lo ri dwags sogs yod pa'i bum mgo can mdzad/ rtsigs pa'i 'gram du 'dod snam la mchod lha gar byed pa/ phyi rol tu rdo ra me ri dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po lte ba stong pa/ rtsibs bzhi sbubs stong can rtsibs kyi rtsa ba las cha phran phyed gsum gyis mtho ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba'i mdun ngos dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir zla gdan/ lte rgyab tu nyi ma dang baX/ rtsibs bzhi dang sgo bzhir pad nyi zhing rkyang gi gdan re gsal gdab dbus kyi gdan steng du rgyu'i sa bon hrīXyig babs pa 'od du zhu nas lte ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du thig le ye shes lnga'i rang gdangs 'od lnga'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba re re bsam/ 'khor rnams ni dper na gtso bo'i chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang gdangs las mi bskyod thugs rje chen po dang byams pa tshad med las shar gyi sgo ma gsal 'debs pas sa bon zur du mi dgos de'ang gtso 'khor rnams gyi mngon rtogs las byang nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab ste/ rten brten pa rnams kyi rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin/ bye brag tu sems 'dzin pa ni/ gzhal yas
khang la mtshon na brtsig pa rim pa lnga la dmigs te/ ched du gsal btab nas reg mthong gi mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de bzhin du phyi'i dur khrod nas nang gi gdan gyi bar thams cad la sems 'dzin/brten pa lha la'ang thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyi mdzod spu dang rta mgrin gyi spyan dbus ma la sems bzung ste spyan dkar nag tshun ma 'dres par gsal 'debs/ rim bzhin shangs dang skan sogs sku'i cha shas so so dang rgyan cha lugs la brtags de nas sgo ma'i bar gyi 'khor rnams la'ang dmigs pa sbo/ de'ang lo zlar spel te nyams khrid byar yod na dmigs pa shin tu zhib par ngo sprod cing zla grangs zhag grangs la tshar dgos pa'i rigs la gtso bo'i sems 'dzin rags pa tsam dang gzhan rnams la mdor bsdus rigs pas dpyod/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol de nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po sogs la sems 'dzin du 'jug /bzlas pa'i tshe rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hrīXdamar po la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros skyabs gnas thams cad mchod cing rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus/ bdag gi zhal du zhugs thugs gar thim pas sku gsum ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par bsam/ des mtshon rang nyid lha so so'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal la brten nas
༄༅ltoX ltoXdamigs pa gong ltar kha spo/ bye brag gi dmigs pa gtso bo'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis bsdus pa'i snang mdzad rigs kyi bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par rang la thim pas nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur te chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byed/ de bzhin du mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal bzung nas mi bskyod rigs kyi 'od zer thim pas zhe sdang sbyangs pa sogs rigs 'greyang 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs pa sogs las bzhi'i dmigs pa so sor spe'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas dngos grub yid bzhin du 'grub cing zhi sogs kyi las rnams thogs pa med par byin no/ /gnyis pa lung a nu yo ga la stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi gdangs snying rje kun snang gi rgyu las srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid 'khor ba dbyings sgrol yab yum du gsal ba'i yab yum kyi sku phru ma phus btab pa 'ja' dmar gyi gur lta bu'i nang du rtsa dbu ma chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba / til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa ste khyad chos bzhi ldan lus kyi srog shing ltar gnas pa'i snying ga dang spyi bo gnyis su rtsa 'dab brgyad pa gdugs kyi rtsibs ma'i dbyibs can re re bsam/ de'i rgyu mtshan dper na tsan+dan gyi dri sdong po kun la khyab kyang rtsa bar bzang zhing khrag lus byings la
khyab kyang rtsa chen rnams nas lhag par babs pa dang 'dra bas 'khor lo gnyis kyi gnad gcun pa'i zab gnad 'di rdzogs chen pa rnams kyi man ngag go /snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi lte bar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la 'khor ba dbyings sgrol yab yum rigs bdag 'od dpag med dang bcas pa/ phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhir rigs bzhi yab yum bcas/ de so so'i rgyab tsam du sgo ma ḍā zhi bzhi zhi ba g.yas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa rin po che'i rgyan ldan sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mtshams kyi rtsa nang bzhi ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gyis dra bas 'brel bar bsgom/ gtso bo'i thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dbu ma'i lam brgyud de spyir bor slebs par brten dung khang gi rtsa 'khor dbus su zla gam dmar por pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng du rta mgrin yab yum phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhir dbang chen rigs bzhi/ so so'i rgyab tsam du sgo ba ging chen sde bzhi g.yas thod khrag 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa rnams gsal gdab/ yum gyi sku'i nang du dbu ma 'khor lo gnyis dang bcas pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa ste 'bras bu sku dang ye shes rnam par dag pa yab yum lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ rang gi snying dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ga'i hrīXlas 'phros pas 'od zer dmar po dbu ma'i lam brgyud de dung khang 'bor lo'i rta
༄tshiltoX ltoXmagrin gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de las phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs/ 'od kyi rnam pa rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs gar thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mor spros te sku gang / yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa do li'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa'i mthar gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od dang bdud rtsi 'phros pa mi bskyod pa'i zhal du zhugs thugs gar thim pas bdud rtsi yum gyi mkhar spro bsdu/ do li sogs sbyor ba rigs gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre/ de nas mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka nas 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa shar gyi sgo ma'i zhal du zhugs sku'i nang gang de las 'phros pa'i bdud rtsis kyang 'tshams kyi shar lho'i rtsa 'dabs gang ba sogs gzhan gsum la'ang sbyar/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ rta mgrin gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas sras bcas spyan drangs/ 'od zer gyi rnam pa rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i rta mgrin gyi thugs gar thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sogs 'khor lugs zhi ba'i gtso bo dang mtshungs gtso bo las 'od zer spros te badz+ra he ru ga'i zhal du zhugs pa sogs rta mgrin ji lta ba nas mtshams kyi rtsa 'khor bdud rtsis gang ba'i bar snying ga dang 'dra/ de nas snying ga dngaspyi bo'i lha las babs
pa'i bdud rtsis dbu ma'i nang kun gang / de nas phy-i dkyil gyi yab kyi sku yi nang gang / rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku gang bas dbu ma dang / 'od zer gnyis 'od zer bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ de nas yum gyi zhal nas rlung gi gdangs ā+oX yig gi rnam pa can thon/ yab gyi zhal du zhugs de snying gar āX'i rnam par gnas rdo rje'i lam nas hūṃX gi rnam par thon te yum gyi pad+mar zhugs nas 'khor mo yug tu rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs nas rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'go brtsams te bde stong gi ye shes skye ba sogs dngos grub mtha' klas pa 'grub bo/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa a ti yo ga ni/ rang sems skye med chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin/ de nyid zung du 'jug pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ yo ga snga ma gnyis ltar rim bzhin bskyed mi dgos par sku gsum gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rdos bcas 'byung ba lnga rang sar dag pa'i yon tan de dag lhun grub rten gzhal yas khang dang rig pa rang byung rang shar ba zhi ba dang de'i rtsal 'gag pa med par khro bo sgra grag stong du bsgrags pa bzlas pa/ 'khor 'das kun rang shar rang grol bde chen du lhun gyis grub pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems la rdzogs te rang sems las
༄tshiltoX ltoXgazhan du rten brten pa kun gang du'ang ma grub pas gzhal yas khang dang lha thams cad sems kyi rol bar nges pa rnyed pa lam 'di'i gtso bo yin pas nyams su blangs zhing phyir rdul tshon lta bu la brten pa'i dkyil 'bor ni sems kyis ched du btags pa'i bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor yin la/ de las nang phung khams skye mched rten brten pa'i sgrub gzhi rang byung gi dkyil 'bor bag la nyal ba sems kyis ched du gsal ba'i dkyil 'bor zab/ de las ma bcos lhun grub rig pa rang byung gi dkyil 'bor 'dus ma byas pa de nyid ches zab pas yo ga gzhan gnyis la'ang 'dis rtsis zin pa gnad du che ba sngon gyi sngags 'chang ral pa can rnams kyi thugs dam gyi snying po yin pas snying gsar pa rnams dgongs 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang gi khrid ni/ lus snang bag chags rags pa dag gyur nas4༷༷ gsang ba'i dbang bskur rtsa rlung man ngag bsgomagiX zhes pa ltar gnas dben par skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i stan bde bar tsog pur rkang ba gnyis bsnol/ lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag lte 'og tu bca'/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mgrin pa cung zad bkug /dpung pa gnyis phyir brkyang lus kyi cha bsgrim/ mig gnyis sna rtser phab/ rlung ro g.yon nas dal ba'i rgyang gis 'bud/ de bzhin du g.yas dang dbus/ yang g.yas sogs gong ltar la drag pa gsum
yang shin tu drag pa gsum 'bud/ mthar mchil ma zhig mid pa dang mnyam du steng rlung cher gyis mnan/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum cung zad dang bcas bsdam yang yar 'then drag pa mi mdzad/ rlung gang thub kyi bar bzung nas mthar sna rtse'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshul gyi gtong / de 'dra kha yar byas pa'i rjes su lus stong sang lta bur bsam pa'i ngang nas chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rang thugs rje chen po yab yum du gsal ba'i sku stong ra'i dbus na rtsa dbu ma khyad chos bzhi ldan yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne rdo rje'i rtsa bar zug pa sba lcag 'bring po tsam pa'i tshad kyi g.yas su ro ma dmar po g.yon du rkyang ma dkar ba la dmar sha re ba'i mdangs can mda' smyug phra shos tsam pa lte 'og nas gyes te 'khor lo rnams la 'khyud de klad rgya'i thad kyi steng nas smin mtshams su tshur gug pa sna bug gnyis po'i nang du zug pa/ mar sne dbu ma'i nang du gug pa cha'i dbyibs can/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'ber lo rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lte ba skyed byed 'ber lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi/ snying ga dran pa'i 'ber lo rtsa 'dab brgyad/ mgrin pa ro 'dus 'ber lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug /spyi bor rtse mo rnam bkod/ 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu/ 'dab ma rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bzhin phub pa'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su rin 'byung yab yum gsal btab/ de'i rtsa dbu ma'i yar sner haX dkar po chu yi
༄༅ltoX ltoXrang bzhin mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ rang nyid kyi gsang ba'i rtsa mdud dbus su a thung shad kyi rnam pa drod kyi rang bzhin dmar hu re ba zhig gsal gdab/ rlung 'jam por sna bug gnyis nas nang du rngub ro rkyang gnyis nas thur du phyin te dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pas sol me la phus btab pa bzhin a shad la phog pas drod je che dang mdog je dmar la song ba'i ngang nas mar me 'bring po tsam zhig dal gyi 'bar ba'i rtse mo rta rnga brgya gshags kyi tshad tsam pa zhig lte ba'i rin 'byung gi gsang gnas nas rtsa lam brgyud de spyi po'i haX la phog pas mar la lcags bsregs bzhin ltem gyi zhu/ de'i rkyen byas nas yab yum gnyis kyi thugs rgyud la bde chen skyes te sbyor ba mdzad pas byang chub gyi sems thams cad rtsa lam brgyud de spyi bo'i haX la thim/ de nas 'o rkyal la lcags thur bsnun pa ltar haṃX las byang sems babs pa skra shad 'dzing bzhin pa'i ngang nas yab yum gnyis kyi sku gang / de nas phyir thon te dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas rang gi gsang ba'i rtsa mdud kyi bar byang sems kyis gang bar bsams shing bum pa can ci nus su bsgom/ rlung mi thub par nye ba na cung zad rngub nas 'dzin cing de rjes sna bug gnyis nas dal bur gtong ba'i tshe dmigs pa rlung dbu mar zhugs te tshangs bug nas sngo sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de ltar zhag grangs ci nus su nan tan bsgom pas drod dang bde ba cher
skye zhing de la brten nas dwangs ma 'chor ba'i nyen byung na a shad lte bar sbo/ snying gar mi bskyod pa yab yum gsal btab ste sgom lugs sngar ltar byas pas gtum mo'i me haX la phog pa sogs gong bzhin la/ byang sems kyi dbu ma brgyud de lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang nas bde drod ma skyes bar bsgom/ yang a shad snying ga dang mgrin pa 'od dpag med gsal btab ste me sbar bas snying ga'i bde drod skye/ a shad mgrin pa dang spyi bo'i snang mdzad gsal ba'i 'bar 'dzag gi mthar yar lud pas spyi bo yang gang bas mgrin pa dang spyi bo'i bde drod skye ba sogs ma byung gi bar nyams su bstar ro/ /de ltar bsgom pas dbu ma'i kha phye nas rtsa mdud phal cher grol/ dwangs ma rgyas pas/ bde stong gi ye shes gong du 'phel/ thun mong gi yon tan dpag tu med pa thob cing 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi khrid la/rang lus thabs ldan ni/ bde drod thob nas shes rab ye shes dbang rdzogs par bskur zhing dga' bzhi'i man ngag bstan4༷༷ ces pa ltar gnas shin tu dben par skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i a wa dhu ti'i yar sner haX yig dang mdun du yid kyis sprul pa'i gzung ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bha ga dang nu ma mngon par rgyas pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can zhig gsal gdab/ de
༄tshiltoX ltoXnyid gsang ba ye shes kyi ḍā ki mar bsgom/ yab yum gnyis kyi mkha' gsang spyi ltar byin gyis rlabs pa ni bsnyen pa/ 'khyud pa dang tsum pa sna tshogs dang bcas te mnyam par sbyor ba ni nye bsnyen/ de nas bsrub cing sbyor ba la bsten nas lte ba'i drod kyis spyi bo'i haX zhu ba'i byang sems mgrin par slob pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su ma myong gi bar du bsgom de bzhin du snying gar mchog dga' lte bar dga' bral/ gsang gnas lhan cig skye dga'i bar bsgom zhing rlung 'dzin pa ni sgrub pa slar yang rlung gis bskul nas gyen du ldog lte bar slob pas rgyu mthun gyi dga' ba/ snying gar rnam smin/ mgrin par skyes bu byed/ spyi por dri bral/'bras bu'i dga' ba rnams nyams su myong / de'ang thog ma'i skabs su rlung dang dmigs pa tsam gyi chog kyang bde ba cher skyes na lto ba ri rab la sbyar/ sor mo bskum/ ñtsa rtse rkan la sbyar/ nyi zla gyen la ldog nyuX ring dang bcas te byang sems yar 'dren dud 'gro'i sprug stangs kyis dgram par bya ba ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /rtsa mdud rdzogs par 'grol phyir gzhan lus thabs ldan la brten nas las la sbyor ba dngos ni/ bde stong ting 'dzin las su rung gyur nas4༷༷ garma mu dra'i krogs 'byin rtsal sbyong bya4༷༷ zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ba deng sang mkho chung bas ma bris shing spro na sher dbang gi skabs su cung zad bstan cing rgyas par klong gsal dang zab rgya
sogs rdzogs chen gyi gzhung g.yin las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ bzhi pa'i dbang bskur 'khor 'das ru shan dbyegiXrtsal sbyangs rgyas gdab mnyen btsal lam gzhugs dngagiX byung gnas 'gro gsum tshang btsal rnal dbab cing ltoX sngon 'gro'i yan lag ma lus rdzogs par bya4༷༷ zhes pa ltar la khrid gzhung du mdor bsdus tsam las ma gsung pa 'dir nyams len 'khyer bde ba'i ched du cung zad spros na ru shan dbye ba/ sgrib pa sbyang ba/ sngon du 'gro ba/ rnal du dbab pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po ru shan dbye ba la/ lus ngag yid gsum las/ dang po lus 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba la/ gnas dben par 'gro ba rigs drug gi spyod tshul tsha dmyal la me mdag ga༄rdzos ba dang / grang dmyal la chur 'jug pa/ yi dwags la zas skom gcod pa/ dud 'gro la theg par dka' ba bskur ba/ mi la zhing las dang mkhar brtsigs pa/ lha min la g.yul sprod pa/ lha la pi waX brdung ba lta bus mtshon pa mdzad srol yod mod/ 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lus ngag yid dang 'khor ba ru shan phye la phyis 'khor bar mi ldog snyam du sems bskyed dmyal ba'i lus kyi skabs gnas der dngos su skyes par bsgom nas/ 'khum pa/ rengs ba/ 'gre ldog 'phra gshag so tham
༄tshiltoX ltoXpa/ 'dar ba rnams dngos su bya/ de nas mi bskyod thugs rje chen po dang dbang chen badz+ra he ru ka sogs zhi khro'i bzhugs stangs sna tshogs byed cing mthar rdo rje'i 'dug stangs lag pa gnyis spyi bor thal mo bskyang sbyar/ rkang pas mthil gnyis sprad nywa bzhi bsgril/ sgal tshigs thad gar bsrang / ltag rtsa drang por 'then/ mig bar snang la ha re bltas pas yar rtse gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje/ mar rtse gsum sku gsum mtshon phyir rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbyibs 'byung ba dang / sgom don kha dog dkar po dang rtse lnga par bslab/ de nas dmyal ba'i lus blang bar sdug bsngal da lta'i bde ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bzhugs stangs rnams la gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs dgag sgrub sogs e 'dug rjes shes rang gi rgyud la bkal nas bltas te/ sngon chad ma rig pa'i dbang gis de ltar myong yang rig pa ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang dbyer med yin pas/ da phyin chad dmyal bar skye 'gyur gyi sbyang gzhi zhi khro'i bzhugs stangs kyis sbyangs pas slad nas dmyal ba'i lus kyi 'brel thag gcod snyam du bsam zhing goms pa'i dbang gis lus la chags zhen tsha grang gi sdug bsngal med pa'i rnam pa shar na ru shan 'byed pa yin pas gdengs tshad ma rnyed kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ngag ru shan dbye ba ni/ a tsa/ a na/ kyi hud/ a chu/ ngu ba sogs smre sngags sna tshogs bya/ de
nas zhi ba'i gsung dbyangs drug cu khro bo gad mo bco brgyad hūṃX ring thung gi snang glu dang phaṭa sogs mang du brjod/ rjes shes lta lugs sogs gong ltar la ngag la nyams theg pa'i gdengs yod med brtag gsum pa sems ru shan dbye ba ni/ gshag cing gtub pa/ 'tshed pa/ rtsa rgyus rnams tshig nas 'khums shing / dbang po'i sgo rnams nas me 'bar ba/ chu lhar rdol ba/ rnag khrag 'dzag pa pad+ma ltar gas pa sogs la nan tan du bsam/ de rjes bde gsal mi rtog pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du 'jog rjes shes sngar bzhin bltas nas sems la nyam nga ba'i 'jigs skrag e 'dug brtag yi dwags la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe/ khrag dang gshang gci sogs yi gar mi 'ong bar zas za ba'i stangs ga rin 'byung zhi khro'i rdo rje ser po/ mjug lus la bkres skom yod med lta ba tsam ma gtogs gong dang 'dra/ ngag la bkres so/ /skom mo sogs bsgyur/ mjug ngag la/ bkres nyams yid la zas skom ma rnyed par ltogs pa gzhan gyis bsrung ba rnyed kyang zar mi gtub pa lta bu'o/ /mjug yid la bkres nyams byol song la gsum gyi lus la sgur bor 'gro ba sogs/ snang mdzad zhi khro/ rdo rje mthing kha mjug lus la ngal dub e 'dug ngag la rta g.yag bya khyi sogs kyi skad sna tshogs/ mjug ngag la smra mi shes pa'i nyams/ yid la chang 'gag gi sbang ma ltar g.yo 'gul
༄tsholtoX ltoXmi nus pa/ gsod spyod rdeg bkol/ mjug dub nyams/ mi la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe logs rgyags pa sogs/ snang mtha'/ zhi khro rdo rje dmar po/ mjug lus la bde sdug ngag la so nam khe spogs sogs kyi gtam sna tshogs/ mjug dga' sdug brjod pa'i nyams yid la skye rga na 'chi sogs/ mjug bde sdug spel ma'i nyams/ lha min la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe g.yul sprod pa sogs/ don 'grub/ zhi khro/ rdo rje ljang gu/ mjug lus la rmas pas zug rngu'i nyams/ ngag la rgyob sod dang zur chag gi skad sogs mjug zhe sdang gi mthus nga ros nyams/ yid la 'thab rtsod byas pas g.yul pham pa'i bcad gtub sogs/mjug khro sems/ lha la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe bdud rtsi'i banyung ba zhim po myong ba'am khrus byed pa sogs/ rin 'byung / zhi khro/ rdo rje ser po/ mjug la zag bcas kyi bde nyams/ ngag la saX skṛ ta'i skad/mjug bde ba'i gtam gyi nyams/ yid la skyed mos tshal du brtse ba dang 'chi 'pho ltung byed sogs/ mjug bde sdug spel ma'i nyams/ so so'i skabs thob kha bsgyur te phyin chad rigs drug du mi skye ba'i gdengs ma rnyed kyi bar du bya/ bshad ma thag pa las spros pa chung ba'i nyams len snying po dril bar 'dod na/ klong gsal gyi sngon 'gro ru shan 'byed pa'i ṭi ka ltar du shan dbye ba rdzogs chen gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa bsnan
na mchog tu 'gyur zhing 'byer bde ba sbas chos yang tig gi stan gcig tu ru shan dbye tshe lus rdo rje'i 'dug stangs/ dmigs pa hūm̐X zhi drag spel nas/ lus rdo rje'i rnam pa de 'phar zhing mchongs te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i steng du phar 'gro ba dang de nas kyang slar shar phyogs kyi zhing khams mngon par dga' ba sogs blos khyud tshad la phar spro zhing / tshur rim gyis bsdus te rang gi stan thog tu slob nas rde'u bkram pa ltar yod 'phro la phaṭa brjod cing dmigs bzlas thams cad rbad bcad de rig 'dzin rgyal ba de dag dang dgongs pa bsres te dar cig bzhag pa sogs la blo sbyangs/ de bzhin du rin chen ldan pad+ma 'od las rab brtsegs sogs phyogs thams cad la bslab/ spros pa chung bar 'dod na 'di nyid gcig pus kyang mthus so/ /gnyis pa sgrib pa sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid kyi lus ma rig 'khrul ba las grub pa 'di'i spyir bor a dkar nag mgrin par su ser nag snying gar mṛ sngo nag lte bar tri dmar nag gsang bar pre ljang nag rkang mthil du dud kha ste rigs drug dang nyon mongs drug gi bag chags dang bcas pa'i sbyang gzhi'i sa bon gsal btab pa la/ sbyong byed gnas gsum du oX āXhūṃX dmigs pa las ye shes kyi me dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas rkang mthil nas rim gyis sa bon drug po bsregs/ rang gzhan gyi sgo gsum gyi ma rig zhabrul pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas
༄tshiltoX ltoXpa thil gyis tshig 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu 'bras thams cad dag ste lus shel gong phyis pa ltar bsam la 'bru gsum dbyangs dang bcas pa bzla'o/ /'di khrid gzhung du mi gsal yang gal che ba'i phyir snying tig gzhan nas kha bkang / dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong sgo gsum gyi sdig pa'i sa bon dang bar chad zhi nas zhen pa ldog khyad par de la brten nas phyis 'khor bar mi 'khyams/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje gsum 'grub bo/ /gsum pa sngon 'gro ni khrid gzhung du 'ga' zhig mi gsal zhing la la 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba dang bsres pa zhig snang ba go bde ba'i phyir logs su bshad pa la lus ngag yid gsum las/dang po lus kyi sngon 'gro ni rdo rje 'dug stangs dang kha dog sngon po rtse lnga pa me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs te rdo rje khong stong du bsam pa'i lus khang rul zhig pa lta bu dang khol bur na ba dang drod skye ba dang sems mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas pa ni tshad do/ /dgos pa gsum ni thun mong lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag bar chad zhi zhen pa ldog khyad par lus 'bor bar mi ltung zhing sprul skur grol/ mthar sku rdo rje'i klong du mya ngan las 'da'o/ /gnyis pa ngag gi sngon 'gro la/ rgyas gdab/ rtsal sbyangs/ mnyen btsal/ lam du gzhug pa dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyas gdab pa ni/ so dang mchu ma reg tsam du rlung / shes pa hūṃX
gsum cig tu bsres la hūm̐X gis glu snyan la ring ba blangs pas snang ba thams cad hūm̐X sngon du rong rong mer mer yod par bsam pa ni phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa ste phyi hūm̐X du rong nge shar ba ni tshad do/ /phyi'i hūm̐X de dag kha dang sna'i sgor zhugs te/ lus kyi nang hūm̐X gis mer khengs snyam pa ni nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa ste lus gang ba dang mi bde snyam pa tshad do/ /dgos pa ni/ phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad rang bzhin med par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa rtsal sbyang ba ni/ hūṃX drag la ngar dang ldan pa brjod cing hūṃX mthing nag me 'bar ba des ri ra ba khang khyim thams cad phar thal tshur thal du phug ste khrol ma bzhin song bar bsam la phyi'i rtsal te phyi'i yul khral khrol du song snyam byed pa ni tshad do/ /hūm̐X des rang gi lus khrol ma bzhin btang bar bsam pa ni nang gi rtsal te chu zla ltar snang ba ni tshad do/ /dgos pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos brdos bcas su snang ba thams cad 'od gsal 'ja' tshon ltar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mnyen btsal ba ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu khru gang ba zhig btsugs pa la shes pa gtad de hūṃX ring bar brjod pas hūṃX gi thag pa nar ra ra song ste shing bu la dkris nas steng du hūṃX yer rer 'dug pa la mnyam par gzhag yang nar ra ra grol te tshur byung nas snying gar gnas par bsam/ yang na shing bu'i rtse mor sleb pa dang rtsa bar mar phungs kyis dbabs te hūṃX rnams khrom
༄༅ltoX ltoXtshogs su sngo rong re yod par bsam/ yang nar ra ra shing bu la dkris/ yang zhig pa sogs la bslab/ shes pa gang gtad du lham mer sdod snyams pa ni tshad do/ /'di'i dus skyes pa rlung sna bug g.yas dang bud med yin na sna bug g.yon nas 'dren pa gnad yin no/ /des dmigs pa gzhan du bsgyur thub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa lam du gzhug pa ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu khru gang ba zhig btsugs pa'am bsam la hūm̐X zhes brjod pas snying ga nas sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐X zhig byung / shing bu de'i rtser yer re bzhag yang hūm̐X zhes rang gi snying gar hrīl gyis byung / de ltar phar 'gro tshur yong la shes pa gtad/ yang na rang gnas pa'i sa yul thams cad ri ra ba khang khyim sogs med par kha dog ljang gu me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du snying ga nas hūm̐X sngon po khru tshad tsam pa mdun nas phar gseg 'gros lta bu'i lam phar 'khyogs tshur 'khyogs la ri dang sa mtshams ma zad kyi bar du phyin par bsam la hūm̐X ring bar brjod/ pha rol tu 'ang mtha' med par phyin pa la sems gtod/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan la sbyor/ des dga' ba skye ba sogs byung ba nyams skye ba'i tshad do/ /des lus ngag gi lam srol du tshud pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /spyi'i dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong ngag sgrib dag cing yon tan thob/ mngon zhen ldog khyad par ngag 'bor bar mi ltung

༄tshiltoX ltoXkyi sprin tshogs dngas bas chos nyid nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gsum pa gnas lugs brtag pa la/ dben pa'i gnas su sgo gsum gyi bya ba rnams btang ste rang babs kyi ngang nas sems zhes pa 'khor 'das gnyis ga'i 'char gzhi byed pa rig rig tur tur 'di'i byung gnas 'gro gsum las dang po byung sa ni/ sems gang las byung rtsar bcad pas rang gi lus longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma sogs dug gsum gyi yul du gyur pa de dag gi gnyen la chags yul/ chags bya/ chags par byed mkhan/ dgra la sdang yul/ sdang bya/ sdang bar byed mkhan/ bar ma la snyoms yul/ snyoms bya/ snyoms byed mkhan rnams kyi gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga la btsal ba/ mi la mtshon na dbang po tshogs drug phung khams skye mched/ bya spyod sogs dran yul du byas te 'di yin nam snyam pa'i rtog pa 'char yang zhib tu dpyad tshe gzhan na mi rnyed par tshe 'di'i mi lus byung bar nges shes rnyed pa lta bu yong yang de'i lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar cha shas phra mo re re nas btsal bas mi rnyed/ sems las sems byung na skad cig rang dus na sems cha gnyis su 'dzin dgos pa la de 'dra blos dpyad mi bzod pa'i phyir sems skye ba med pa gtan la phebs pas chos sku blo bral chen po thog ma'i zad sa shes so/ /gnyis pa bar du gnas pa med pa ni/ phyi snod

༄༅ltoX ltoXbazhag gi ngang la rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang de'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pa na sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin zhig 'gro bas mnyam rjes bsre zhing dge sbyor gyi rgyun bskyangs/ de dag thams cad kyi gzhi ma rig pa'i dbang gi bden par med bzhin du gnyis su bzung bar brten/ dug lnga rgyas shing kun gyi rtsa ba bdag gces 'dzin gyis lan pas de gar yod brtag pa na phyi nang gi snod bcud gang gi steng nas kyang ma rnyed pas sems kyi 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo tsam du thag chod/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong gang shar 'dzin med kyi ngang la cham gyis 'jog de ma zad phyi nang gi snod bcud rnams la'ang / byung gnas 'gro gsum dpyad pas gzugs snang stong / sgra grags stong / sems rig stong ste tha snyad kyi chos kun ka dag tu thag bcad pa'i mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la rjes thob tu 'khrul shes thams cad chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis nyams 'og tu tshud par byas pas mnyam yangs chen por blo bde'o/ /dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong sems kyi sdig pa 'dag yon tan skye/ mngon zhen ldog khyad par sems 'khor bar mi 'khyams zhing chos skur grol/ mthar thug rdo rje'i klong du mya ngan las 'da'o/ /bzhi pa rnal du bab pa ni/ ru shan dbye ba man gyi dmigs skor rnams kyi bar mtshams su skabs dang bstun nas nyams su len pa ni bde ba'i mal du lus

༄tsholtoX ltoXrmugs pa/ 'byams pa/ mi dran pa/ brgyal ba lta bu 'byung / de ni 'khrul ba'i ma rgan mo 'o1nga ba bzhin yin la/ sems zhes bya ba zi 'ordzong long ba g.yo bun bun pa/ mnyam khrig ge ba/ rgyang yeng yeng ba/ ti 'khor 'khor ba/ nga bdag cher byed pa lta bu zhig skyes pa de srid pa'i btson rar 'jug pa'i ma rig pa de la brten nas bdag gzhan 'byung / bdag la brten nas 'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ ser sna/ gzhan la brten nas zhe sdang / phrag dog de lnga las nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du gyes te 'gyu byed dbugs kyi rta la zhon/ mi dge ba ci yang byed cing sdug bsngal gang yang myong ba/ dus rgyun du 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di rig na de las grol bas gdod nas rig pa'i ye shes thig le nyag gcig gzhis kyis 'dug tshul 'di nyid ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu rgya chad phyogs lhung spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad las 'das par ye nas gnas pas dang por 'di nas 'byung ba med/ rang bzhin gsal ba stong pa phyang chad du ma song bar gdangs rig pa'i rang rtsal ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku ye nas sgrub par 'dir med par stong pas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ thugs rje ma 'gags kun la khyab cing snang nus pa sprul pa'i skur ye nas grub pa'i mkhyen cha rang bzhin gyis gsal ba thugs rje ye shes kyi snying po can yul yul can gyi shes

༄tsholtoX ltoXpo ni/ khregs chod zab mos 'khor 'das snang ba rnams4༷༷ sems kyi rtsal snang tsam du ngo sprod cing ltoX zhes pa ltar gzhi 'khor ba'i 'khrul gzugs lam theg dgu'i bgrod tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad sems kyi snang cha ma 'gags tsam 'di'i gdengs sam rol pa yin pas na/ kun byed las/ sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes yon tan dang / /sems can las dang bag chags la sogs pa/ snang srid snod bcud bsdus pa thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ye nas yin/ /zhes pa'i don ltar byed mkhan kun sems las ma 'das pas chu las chu lhar rdol ba ltar gzhan nas btsal du med pas snang ba sems su thag chod par nges pa ma rnyed kyi bar du bsgom/ 'di sems tsam lugs kyi lta ba dang mthun par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa sems stong par ngo sprod pa ni/ sems snang sna tshogs ji ltar shar ba rnams/ rang ngo spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang ltoX zhes pa ltar sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid chos kyi sku ste de'i sems snang ma 'gags tsam gyi rang rtsal la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'gags med du rang snang yang chos rnams kyi ngo bo stong pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las bral bas/ ji skad du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes 'byung bas de shes na gnas skabs su nyon mongs pas mi gnod cing 'khrul gzhi rtsad nas chod/ rtag

༄tshiltoX ltoXskugiX zhes pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems kyi 'khrul snang ma 'gags tsam yin pa de 'khrul med du shes pa'i thabs su zung 'jug tu ngo sprod na'ang rig pa ka dag chen po'i dbyings su spros pa dang bral ba'o/ /de'ang mu tig phreng ba las/ sems dang ye shes dbye ba ni/ mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems dang rig pa gnyis ni rnam pa kun tu tha dad pas kun gzhi'i sems ni glo bur gyi kun rdzob yul snang gi spros pa can rkyen las byung ba'i 'dus byas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa can de gnas pa glo bur gnas shing / las rlung gis drangs te dbang po'i sgo rnams las thon nas tshogs brgyad kyi yul la longs spyod/ byed las bden 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu 'khor ba skye la/ rig pa rang byung gi rgyal po ni mthar thug don dam pa yul yul can gyi spros pa dang bral ba rgyus ma skyed pa'i 'dus ma byas gnyis 'dzin las 'das pa de gnas pa yang / kun bzang thugs kyi me long las/ tsit+ta snying gi gzhal yas na4༷༷ rig pa zhi ba'i sku ru bzhugs4༷༷ zhes pa ltar tsit+ta rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum 'dus kyi bdag nyid ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs te chos nyid ye shes kyi rang snang las thon nas chos nyid kyi yul la longs spyod la/ glo ba dang snying gi bar du rtsa gro sog gi sbu gu tsam
